pitch.heading: Tessary on the Ossel, in the week the Long Muster came home
pitch.text: The legions of Tessary have come home from eleven years' war, and some of them are walking into the sea. An eel-wife of the Withies has pinned a notice at the Landgate: her son set his boots together on the Tideline Steps a fortnight ago and walked into the water, and she will give her savings to whoever can tell her where he went. You have come down the marsh road with a little coin and no particular plans.
